q: More than one student ___ failed in the test.
e:
'More than one' শব্দগুচ্ছ দেখতে বহুবচন মনে হলেও পরে একবচন noun থাকে এবং Verb একবচন হয়। 'Many a' গঠনেও ঠিক একই নিয়ম।
মনে রাখুন:
More than one man has died.
Many a man has failed.
ভাব: একবচন noun + singular verb

q: Neither the trainer nor the players ______ available for the post-match interview.
Which one is grammatically correct?
o: Each student have submitted their homework.
Each of the students have submitted their homework.
Each of the student has submitted their homework.
Each of the students has submitted their homework.

q: Choose the correct sentence-
o: A hundred miles were a long distance to travel on foot.
A hundred mile is a long distance to travel on foot.
A hundred miles is a long distance to travel on foot.

q: Each of the girls _____ present.
Lunch excluding drinks ____ tk 200 per person.

Which sentence is grammatically correct?
o: The cattles are grazing in the field.
The cattle was grazing in the field.
The cattle is grazing in the field.
The cattle are grazing in the field.

q: More than one player _____ selected for the award.
e: More than one-এর পরে noun ও verb দুটিই singular হয়, তাই More than one player is selected। কাঠামো: More than one + singular noun + singular verb। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: More than one candidate has applied। তবে More than two বা three-এর পরে noun ও verb দুটিই plural হয়, যেমন More than two students are absent।

q: One of my friends (be) a doctor.
Tina as well as Tumpa _________ going to the party tonight.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: Each student have been present today.
e: Subject-এর আগে each, every বা no থাকলে verb সাধারণত singular হয়। Each একটি singular determiner, তাই Each student-এর সঙ্গে is বসে। Have been বা were plural আর কোনো verb ছাড়া বাক্য অসম্পূর্ণ, তাই সেগুলো ঠিক নয়। বাক্যটির অর্থ: প্রত্যেক ছাত্র আজ উপস্থিত।

q: Twenty thousand dollars _____ lots of money.
The president, along with the entire cabinet, _______ present at the meeting.
Fill in the blanks: A basket of rotten oranges ____________ thrown away.
Arabian Nights ____ still wonderful to read.
The committee presented _____ recommendations to the board.
e: Committee একটি collective noun, এবং একক দল হিসেবে কাজ করলে এটিকে neuter ধরে singular pronoun দিয়ে নির্দেশ করা হয়। তাই শূন্যস্থানে its বসে। মনে রাখুন: its হলো it-এর possessive রূপ, আর it's মানে it is বা it has; দুটিকে গুলিয়ে ফেলা চলবে না। there কোনো মালিকানা বোঝায় না এবং their বহুবচনের মালিকানা বোঝায়, তাই এখানে খাপ খায় না।

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: Neither Ali’s parents nor he was present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali’s parents nor he were present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali nor his parents was present at the ceremony.
Neither Ali nor his parents were present at the ceremony.
